name: Directed campaign kit
outcome: Approve one product hero, build two campaign formats, and compare one directed revision with the original.
summary: Upload one product image so the app can write the brief and three campaign directions automatically.
Build campaign formats from the accepted image and preserve the original when you revise it.
caveats: Image edits can change product details. Compare every take with the product reference.
SVG exports preserve editable text. PNG exports are flat images.
Choose compatible language and image-edit models using your own provider keys.

apps.role: Direct and revise the campaign from one screen.

steps.handoff: In the app, upload the product image, review the AI-written brief and directions, choose one, then check product identity and composition before accepting.
Keep the accepted hero and exact copy together in 4:5 and 9:16.
Compare the revision with the original, then use the same composition workflow.
